notes.title: Patch 1.4.5：An update on the voice chat issue
notes.notes: [h3]In the update implemented on 2025/6/16 15:00 PDT | 2025/6/17 0:00 CEST, we applied the following bug fixes and feature adjustments:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the transceiver’s effective range during the Investigation Phase was the same as that of regular voice chat.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a voice chat issue on the spectator screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the default setting for the “Voice Chat” filter in room search to “No set.”[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]We apologize for any inconvenience caused by these issues.[/h3][p][/p][h3]Thank you for your continued support of [b]DEATH NOTE Killer Within[/b]![/h3]
